title: C link: LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES undefined, desync_fsm test cannot compile (spec 09 14.7)
description: Spec 09 14.7 R-09-141: BEACON_TIMEOUT = 3x superframe. Commit 656e367b29 removed #define LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES 3 from lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link.h but tdma.c:156 still uses the macro (only remaining refs: tdma.c:156 and a comment in lichen/tests/desync_fsm/main.c:188; rg verified repo-wide). lichen/tests/desync_fsm cannot compile (agent-verified gcc -fsyntax-only: undeclared). Classification: divergent/regression. Fix: reintroduce the define (or consume CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT from Kconfig link/Kconfig:215-223, default 3) and pin with BUILD_ASSERT like lichen/tests/csma_constants/main.c. Vectors: tdma_ccp_fsm.json.
close_reason: Fix already present on beads-worker-1 and now pinned: link.h:246 defines LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES 3u (worker1's earlier merge fix restored the duplicate-define removal that main's sync lost; tdma.c:156 consumes it and desync_fsm compiles — ctest green). Declined the Kconfig-consolidation option: CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT (link/Kconfig:215) governs the CCP ACQUIRING beacon-listen timeout, a different FSM from the 14.7 RECOVERING bound this macro pins; coupling a configurable knob to the spec-pinned RECOVERING constant would change tested semantics. Added a _Static_assert in tests/desync_fsm pinning the value ==3 so future value drift fails at compile with a clear reason. NOTE for the sync janitor: main's link.h is missing the define (merge regression from the worker1 header dedup in bead b7z9.52's report) — take the definition from beads-worker-1 when merging, or main's tdma.c and desync_fsm remain broken.
